finding_key: packages/backend/src/document/document.service.spec.ts::`documentservice.touchupdatedat` — the core new persistence primitive — has no test at all
evidence: Verified against the supplied files: `document.service.spec.ts` (31 lines) contains only two `updateDocument` cases and its Prisma stub exposes only `document.update`, not `updateMany`, so `touchUpdatedAt` (document.service.ts, the `updateMany where { id, updatedAt: { lt: at } }` monotonic guard) is never exercised. `yorkie-event.controller.spec.ts` injects `touchUpdatedAt` as a jest mock, so it asserts only the arguments the controller passes, never the `lt` filter or the missing-document no-op; the diff adds no e2e coverage either (the PR's own todo explicitly marks the DB-backed advance-only e2e as deferred, and no pre-existing e2e spec is touched). Real gap, but low impact: the untested code is a three-line Prisma call, and the monotonic semantics are enforced by the query itself rather than app logic.
